university.name: Cardiff Metropolitan University
university.summary: Cardiff Metropolitan University is in Cardiff, the capital of Wales. It teaches undergraduate and postgraduate taught courses across management, technology and other schools, accepts international applicants, and publishes a country-by-country guide to entry qualifications including Pakistan.
university.eligibility_note: Licensed student sponsor (gov.uk register of student sponsors, file dated 2026-10-07, Student route)

courses.title: Computer Science (with Specialist Pathways) BSc (Hons)
courses.duration_text: 3 years full-time; 4 years with a foundation year or a year-long placement; 5 years with both
courses.overview: A full-time computing degree with robotics and Internet of Things pathways. Year 1 modules cover programming, operating systems, computational thinking and web and database design. Foundation year and placement year routes are available.
courses.academic_requirements: Typical offer 104 to 112 UCAS tariff points; minimum three A levels including grades CCC; IB Diploma 2 x H5. Five GCSEs at grade C/4 or above including English and Mathematics.
courses.english_requirements: Academic IELTS 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in all elements, or equivalent.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Country page lists, for Year 1 entry to a 3-year degree, HSSC Intermediate in the Pre-Engineering or Pre-Medical stream with a 60% pass plus IELTS 6.0, or HSSC Intermediate in Science, Humanities or Commerce plus a recognised Foundation Course. Year 0 / 4-year degree route: HSSC Intermediate with a 60% pass.
courses.notes: Course page says September and January intakes without a year, so no intake label is recorded. 2027/28 international undergraduate fee of GBP 16,000 comes from the university 2027/28 fees page, not from the course page. Year 1 modules are not labelled compulsory or optional on the page; no options are listed. The Pakistan percentage rule is attached to the intermediate route as published; the page does not state a CGPA.

courses.title: Data Science MSc
courses.duration_text: Full-time 12 to 18 months depending on start date; part-time 3 years also offered
courses.overview: A taught master's in data science with PgC and PgD exit awards. Compulsory modules cover big data, programming for data analysis, analytics and visualisation, information security and a technology dissertation. Applicants need a relevant first degree.
courses.academic_requirements: An undergraduate degree or equivalent in a relevant area such as Computing or Information Systems with a minimum 2:2, or a suitable professional qualification.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall or equivalent for applicants whose first language is not English. No band minimums are listed on the course page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Country page lists for postgraduate study a four-year Bachelor's degree with 60% for courses requiring a 2:2 equivalent, from a recognised Pakistani institution.
courses.notes: Course page says September and January intakes without a year, so no intake label is recorded. The GBP 17,600 figure is the 2027/28 international 'Postgraduate Masters' fee on the university fees page; the course page itself gives no fee, so the client should confirm it applies to this course. The fee is a total for a one-year-plus full-time MSc, not an annual rate.

courses.title: MBA Master of Business Administration
courses.duration_text: 12 to 16 months depending on start date
courses.overview: A campus-based MBA at Cardiff with five compulsory modules, two options or a specialist pathway, and a final project. Pathways include business analytics, finance, human resources, marketing and project management. Entry is by degree or management experience.
courses.academic_requirements: One of: a minimum UK 2:2 degree from a recognised university; a minimum of five years relevant management experience; or another professional qualification deemed acceptable.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 6.0 overall or equivalent for applicants whose first language is not English. No band minimums are listed on the course page.
courses.experience_requirements: A minimum of five years relevant management experience is accepted as an alternative to a degree.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Country page lists for postgraduate study a four-year Bachelor's degree with 60% for courses requiring a 2:2 equivalent, from a recognised Pakistani institution.
courses.notes: Course page says September, January and May intakes without a year, so no intake label is recorded. The GBP 19,500 figure is the 2027/28 international MBA fee on the university fees page; the course page gives no fee. Fee is a total for the course, not annual. The course is also delivered through partner institutes (TNE); this record covers the Cardiff campus route only. The Pakistan percentage applies to the degree route only, not the experience route.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate Scholarship Award
scholarships.summary: An automatic award for full-fee-paying international undergraduates studying full-time on campus. The applicant must apply by the intake deadline and accept the offer by the deposit deadline. The published terms cover 2026/27 only.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full-fee-paying international undergraduates, full-time, on campus. Not for sponsored students, those with credit exemptions reducing fees, or distance learners. One Cardiff Met scholarship only.
scholarships.deadline_note: Accept the offer by the deposit deadline for the intake. Dates not stated; 2027/28 terms not yet published.
scholarships.notes: Page does not state whether the amount is paid once or each year, so value_basis one_off is the cautious reading and should be confirmed.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor Scholarship Award
scholarships.value_text: Up to GBP 3,500 (published for students starting in 2026/27)
scholarships.summary: Offered on a number of MA and MSc programmes, based on evidenced academic and/or professional experience. Only taught postgraduate courses carrying the GBP 17,600 fee qualify. Applicants are considered automatically.
scholarships.criteria_text: Applicants to selected MA and MSc taught programmes with evidenced academic and/or professional experience; only courses with the GBP 17,600 fee qualify. One Cardiff Met scholarship only; not for sponsored students.
scholarships.deadline_note: Accept the offer by the deposit deadline for the intake. Dates not stated; 2027/28 terms not yet published.
scholarships.notes: The page does not list which programmes are included, so eligibility of the MSc Data Science is not confirmed.

scholarships.name: MBA Scholarship Award
scholarships.value_text: Up to GBP 4,000 (published for students starting in 2026/27)
scholarships.summary: Awarded to MBA applicants on the basis of evidenced academic and/or professional work experience, with automatic consideration. The published terms cover 2026/27 only.
scholarships.criteria_text: MBA applicants with evidenced academic and/or professional work experience. One Cardiff Met scholarship only; not for sponsored students.
scholarships.deadline_note: Accept the offer by the deposit deadline for the intake. Dates not stated; 2027/28 terms not yet published.

scholarships.name: Full Fee Discount Award
scholarships.value_text: Up to GBP 1,000 for paying the total course fee by the deposit deadline (published for 2026/27)
scholarships.summary: A discount for full-time undergraduate, postgraduate taught and MBA students who pay the total course fee shown on the offer letter by the deposit deadline for their intake. Not available for PGCE or reduced-rate courses.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full-time UG, PGT or MBA students whose total course fees are received by the deposit deadline for the intake. Not for PGCE or courses with a reduced fee due to credit exemptions.
scholarships.deadline_note: Full fees must be received by the deposit deadline for the intake. Date not stated; 2027/28 terms not yet published.
scholarships.notes: The page's worked example shows the discount applied after a scholarship, so it appears combinable with the other awards; the client should still confirm.

scholarships.name: Alumni Scholarship Award
scholarships.value_text: 20% reduction in course fees (published for students starting in 2026/27)
scholarships.summary: A 20% fee reduction for Cardiff Met undergraduate degree holders, including graduates of partner institutions, who enrol on a taught postgraduate programme in Cardiff. The published terms cover 2026/27 only.
scholarships.criteria_text: Cardiff Met undergraduate degree holders (including TNE partner graduates) enrolling on taught postgraduate programmes in Cardiff. Self-funded; sponsorship rules apply. One Cardiff Met scholarship only.
scholarships.deadline_note: No deadline stated; 2027/28 terms not yet published.
scholarships.notes: A separate Alumni Discount page (https://www.cardiffmet.ac.uk/support/fees-and-finance/bursaries-and-scholarships/alumni-discount/) also gives 20% off for graduates on September 2026 postgraduate starts, open to international graduates. Whether the two are the same award or can be combined is not stated; the client should confirm. The international page does not say whether the 20% applies for the whole course; value_basis total is the reading used.

could_not_verify: No 2027 intake month shown on any course page; September and January (and May for the MBA) are shown without a year.
The 2027/28 international fees are category fees from the university fees page; none of the three course pages state a fee.
Scholarship terms are published for 2026/27 only; 2027/28 terms were not found.
Page does not state a CGPA for Pakistan; only percentages.
conflicting_sources: The BA Business and Management page contains two different year 1 module lists, so that course was not used.
excluded_and_why: BA Business and Management: conflicting module lists and no international fee on the course page.
International Foundation in Management: legacy page with no date, no fee and no start dates; the 2027/28 fees page lists no international foundation fee.
Sanctuary Award: for people seeking sanctuary with irregular migration status, value not stated.
Performance Sport Scholarships and the home alumni and Fee and Access Plan items: not confirmed open to Pakistani applicants.
client_should_confirm: Confirm September 2027 and January 2028 intakes and application deadlines.
Confirm the 2027/28 fee applies to each named course and that MSc Data Science qualifies for the Vice Chancellor Scholarship.
Confirm 2027/28 scholarship values and whether the Alumni Scholarship and Alumni Discount are one award.
